preconditions.expression: all(len(ladder) == 2 and 1 <= ladder[0] < ladder[1] <= 100 for ladder in ladders)
preconditions.description: Each ladder is a list of two integers where the start is less than the end, and both are within 1 to 100.

preconditions.expression: all(len(snake) == 2 and 1 <= snake[0] > snake[1] >= 1 for snake in snakes)
preconditions.description: Each snake is a list of two integers where the start is greater than the end, and both are within 1 to 100.

preconditions.expression: all(ladder[0] != 1 and ladder[0] != 100 and ladder[1] != 1 and ladder[1] != 100 for ladder in ladders)
preconditions.description: Neither square 1 nor square 100 is the start or end of any ladder.

preconditions.expression: all(snake[0] != 1 and snake[0] != 100 and snake[1] != 1 and snake[1] != 100 for snake in snakes)
preconditions.description: Neither square 1 nor square 100 is the start or end of any snake.

preconditions.expression: len(set(start for ladder in ladders for start in ladder)) + len(set(start for snake in snakes for start in snake)) <= 100
preconditions.description: No square is the start of more than one ladder or snake.

postconditions.description: The result is either -1 (no solution) or a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of rolls (at most 100).

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (all(1 <= current <= 100 for current in path) and path[-1] == 100)
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the path (implicitly) starts at 1 and ends at 100, with each step being a valid move (including ladders and snakes).

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (all(1 <= path[i+1] - path[i] <= 6 for i in range(len(path)-1) if path[i+1] != path[i] + (path[i+1] - path[i])) or path[i+1] == path[i] + (path[i+1] - path[i]))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, each move is either a die roll (1 to 6) or a ladder/snake transition, and no move overshoots 100.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (not any(1 <= path[i] <= 100 and path[i] in [ladder[0] for ladder in ladders] and path[i+1] != ladder[1] for i in range(len(path)-1)) and not any(1 <= path[i] <= 100 and path[i] in [snake[0] for snake in snakes] and path[i+1] != snake[1] for i in range(len(path)-1)))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, all ladder and snake transitions are correctly followed (no skipped transitions).

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (all(1 <= path[i] <= 100 and (path[i] not in [ladder[0] for ladder in ladders] or path[i+1] == ladder[1]) and (path[i] not in [snake[0] for snake in snakes] or path[i+1] == snake[1]) for i in range(len(path)-1)))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the path correctly follows all ladder and snake transitions.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (return_value == len([x for x in path if x != path[0]]) - 1)
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the return value equals the number of rolls (transitions) in the path.
